Target company: Meta Platforms (META). Meta operates Facebook, Instagram, WhatsApp and related social products; advertising is a major business activity. It also develops virtual and augmented reality products.

Focal announcement: Meta’s Q1 2023 Security Reports: Protecting People and Businesses.

Decision cutoff: 2023-05-03T23:59:59-04:00. Use only information available before this cutoff.

Source: Meta’s Q1 2023 Security Reports: Protecting People and Businesses. Published date: 2023-05-03. URL: https://about.fb.com/news/2023/05/metas-q1-2023-security-reports.

Condensed source passage, selected from the supplied excerpt; other details are omitted: We know that safety and security are top of mind for people using our apps, including businesses and advertisers. It’s been more than 10 years since our bug bounty program began working with the security research community, 10 years since we first published transparency reports on government data requests , over five years since we started sharing takedowns of covert influence operations and five years since we published our first community standards enforcement report . Since March alone, our security analysts have found around 10 malware families posing as ChatGPT and similar tools to compromise accounts across the internet. For instance, we’re launching a new support flow for businesses impacted by malware. In today’s Q1 Adversarial Threat report , we shared findings about nine adversarial networks we took action against for various security violations.
